title: Random, Sporadic Crashes from Tooltips Anywhere in Godot Editor
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible In All Stable Releases from 4.4 to 4.7, Possibly Earlier

### System information

Windows 11 - Vulkan (Forward+) - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 - AMD Ryzen 9 5900X 12/24-Core CPU - 32 GB RAM

### Issue description

For over two years now I have been experiencing completely random and very infrequent crashes of the Godot Editor. When these crashes occur there are no error messages and the logs reveal nothing out of the ordinary.

I haven't reported the issue this entire time because I could not narrow down the cause given that it only happens about once or twice per 10~20 hours of work, but I am finally noticing a pattern: It seems to be related to tooltips because the crash always seems to happen while the mouse is hovering over something which should generate a tooltip, but then the tooltip doesn't show up and instead I get the spinning blue cursor, and seconds later the Godot Editor disappears; no error messages, nothing in the log files, all changes lost since the last save.

### Steps to reproduce

This happens so infrequently I have not yet found a way to consistently reproduce the problem. All I know is that it happens when a tooltip in the Godot Editor attempts to show up, and then the tooltip never does. It could be ANY tooltip: Properties, Debugger, Project Settings, Node Selection, any window, anywhere.
